body:
Design the idle state of the customer-search screen for **mifos-x-open-banking**, an Open Banking KMP super-app for consumer retail banking and field officer agent banking powered by Open Bank Project API v7.

Palette: primary #B2D188, on_primary #1F3701, primary_container #354E16, on_primary_container #CDEDA3, secondary #A0CFCB, on_secondary #003735, secondary_container #1F4E4B, on_secondary_container #BCEBE7, error #FFB4AB, background #12140E, on_background #E3E3D8, surface #12140E, on_surface #E3E3D8, surface_variant #44483D, on_surface_variant #C5C8BA, surface_container #1E201A, surface_container_high #282A24, outline #8F9285, outline_variant #44483D, pending #E8A317, nav_active_indicator #354E16.

**Component 1 — App Bar** (64dp tall, full width): Title "Find Customer" Outfit Medium 18sp #E3E3D8 left-aligned 16dp. Background #12140E.

**Component 2 — Text Field** (full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 16dp): Filled search field 48dp tall, 24dp corner radius, background #1E201A. Leading search icon 20dp #8F9285, placeholder "Search customers" Outfit Regular 14sp #8F9285 (unfocused, cursor absent). detail_screen archetype idle state.

**Component 3 — Chip Row** (full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 12dp, horizontally scrollable): 4 filter chips 32dp. "All" selected: background #354E16, label #CDEDA3. Others outlined #44483D, labels #C5C8BA.

**Component 4 — Button** (full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 12dp): Outlined button 40dp, "Scan Customer ID" Outfit Medium 13sp #B2D188, QR icon #B2D188.

**Component 5 — Hero** (centered, top margin 48dp, horizontal padding 48dp): Illustration 120dp x 120dp, magnifier with people icon outline in #44483D on #12140E. Subtext "Search by name, ID number, or phone" Outfit Regular 14sp #8F9285 centered top margin 16dp. Max 2 lines.

**Component 6 — Button** (full width minus 32dp insets, top margin 40dp): Filled button 48dp, 12dp radius, background #B2D188, label "Onboard New Customer" Outfit SemiBold 14sp #1F3701. Below: outlined button "Onboard Business Customer" Outfit Medium 14sp #E3E3D8, outline #44483D.

Do not use em-dash anywhere in text. Do not make any headline more than 3 lines or any subtitle more than 25 words. Do not break the dark page theme between sections. Do not place light text on light buttons or dark text on dark buttons.

Layout on #12140E. The earth-green #B2D188 on the scan button and onboarding CTA signals readiness in the idle detail_screen state, grounding the field officer workflow in the taste-default banking aesthetic.
